_comment: Canonical PLC address map for the farm gantry. Both Gantry Studio and the Manuel Kontrol app should load THIS file rather than each hardcoding its own addresses. Modbus-TCP holding registers. 32-bit values occupy two consecutive words, LOW WORD FIRST, IEEE-754 float32.
_layout_warning: X DOES NOT USE THE SAME STRIDE AS Y AND Z. Y is based at 1030 and Z at 1050, both with offsets +0 jogf, +1 jogb, +2 go, +3 home, +4 target, +6 vel, +8 accel, +10 decel, +12 pos. X is based at 1020 but only its jog/go/home/target/pos live there, and its pos sits at +6 where Y and Z keep vel. X's vel/accel/decel were relocated down to 1000-1007. Assuming a uniform stride for X puts its decel write onto 1030/1031, which are Y jog forward and Y jog backward.

axes.name: X
axes._note: irregular: vel/accel/decel are down at 1000-1007, pos is at base+6

unmapped._comment: 0 means not wired yet; the app treats it as a harmless no-op

reserved._comment: Do not allocate anything here without re-running plc_map.py check
reserved.1004-1005: gap in the X parameter block
reserved.1011-1019: gap before the X command block
reserved.1028-1029: gap between X pos and Y jogf - the buffer that keeps a stride mistake from being worse

conventions.target_units: PLC counts, not mm - convert with counts-per-mm from gantry_calib.json
conventions.float_word_order: low word at the base address, high word at base+1
